content: Hi Bob, can you please send me the Q3 financial report by end of Friday? We need it for the board presentation on Monday.
Sure Alice, I promise I will have the Q3 report ready and sent over to you by Friday at 5 pm. Count on it.
Hi Bob, just following up on the Q3 report. Are you still on track to deliver it by Friday? Let me know if you need anything.
Still on track, Alice. I am finalizing the numbers now and will send the Q3 report before 5 pm Friday as promised.
Dave, once QA gives the green light on the build, can you commit to deploying the hotfix to production? We are blocked until it is live.
Yes Carol, I promise to deploy the hotfix within two hours once QA approves. I am waiting on them before I can proceed.
Dave, QA has approved the build. The dependency is resolved and you are clear to deploy the hotfix to production.
Carol, QA approval is in. Deploying the hotfix to production now. Should be live within the hour.
Frank, can you review and sign off on the partnership agreement today? Legal needs it before end of business.
